best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.9-1.2 m, 170 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 77/100, and wind is the main risk.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at low tide can still make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia punchy.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot.
